scope: Fixture-only schema admission, typed round-trip and private storage history; no evaluator, device, service or product acceptance.

neutralProducer.status: reviewed archival preparation; not default-branch or native acceptance

transport.format: gzip; level 9; mtime 0; exact original uncompressed bytes

privateAndroidStorage.observationFormatMeaning: The verified head at the named action boundary; an interruption records its first reopened head before subsequent retry and restoration assertions. Original input bytes and historical meaning must still be retained after every assertion.

updateRule: Keep original producer identities and bytes. A changed shared profile requires a newly versioned canonical producer and affected-client review; a changed private bundle requires a new private version and explicit historical migration expectations. Do not regenerate old snapshots with the current writer or treat a hash update as semantic approval.
